name: plan_pomodoros
description: Replace only the pending draft for separate user confirmation, even during focus/break. Never replaces the confirmed plan, resets progress, confirms or starts. plannedCount and item counts are TODAY'S TOTAL including completed focuses and the current running/paused focus, not additional focuses. Read get_timer first; total must be >= focusIndex. Confirmation keeps the current phase deadline and completed progress.

items.description: Optional single-line tasks. Sum of count must equal plannedCount; assist states whether she can help alongside the user.

name: start_focus
description: Start the next focus of an already user-confirmed plan. The next focus never starts automatically.

name: pause
description: Pause the current Pomodoro timer without cancelling the plan.

name: stop
description: End only the confirmed plan; never discard a pending draft. An unfinished focus is not counted as completed.

name: get_timer
description: Read the confirmed plan, pending proposal, current phase/deadline, completedCount (finished focuses only), and focusIndex (includes the current focus). Use today's totals when proposing, never just remaining/additional focuses.
